name: Shop Orders
description: E-commerce order management list with status views and counts (to fulfil, unpaid, risk review, completed), fulfilment SLA countdowns, fraud-risk flags, expandable line items with subtotal / discount / tax / shipping math, per-order currency, search by order, customer or SKU, and bulk mark-fulfilled for paid orders.

props.name: orders
props.description: { id, number, customer, placedAt, channel, payment, fulfillment, lines[], discount?, shipping?, taxRate?, risk?, currency? }

props.name: fulfilSlaHours
props.description: Hours before an unfulfilled paid order is late

props.name: onFulfill
props.description: Bulk fulfil handler; enables selection of paid, unshipped orders

usage: orderTotals(order) is exported and rounds each component to cents.
